paragraphs: The S-Type 2.5 V6 uses the AJ-V6 — a 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine. It was fitted from 1999 to 2008 across the X200 generation. The S-Type has been part of the Jaguar range since 1999, though it's no longer in production and has been succeeded by the XF.
about.boldParagraph: The S-Type 2.5 V6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.5-litre V6 petrol engine fitted to the S-Type from 1999 to 2008 (X200). Known for timing chain tensioner failure — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V6 rebuild.
